about: Which skills each stage reads by default. A key is a stage id (every recipe) or <recipe>/<stage> (that recipe only, which wins); a value is a list of skill names (craft/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, or the user's own in data/craft/skills/). The Context tab writes the user's changes to data/craft/stage-skills.json in the same shape, where a key replaces the shipped list for that stage.
